passes.name: Resource research and professional capability review
Skill Check authoring and assessment maps

findings.message: External services and resources were verified during generation and must be rechecked before a future revision.

semanticValidation.method: Human-led AI author review opened current professional and authority sources, compared each point-of-use candidate, inspected every Week story, tested each question option for one defensible answer, traced hidden prerequisites, and ran five adversarial passes before deterministic validation.
findingsReviewed: Moved React after platform, JavaScript, DOM, Git, tooling, TypeScript, and initial testing foundations.
Kept documentation optional/reference early except bounded tutorial-shaped authority paired with immediate Studio work.
Removed external state-library requirements because local, derived, shared, URL, and server state reasoning is the stronger junior foundation.
Excluded a required meta-framework because it would distort the platform-first graduation boundary; recorded it as a post-graduation extension.
Separated quiz understanding from practical coding evidence and supplied ten distinct targets per Week only because the current runtime requires ten.
Added deliberate debugging, accessibility, responsive, API-failure, security, performance, review, deployment, and capstone evidence throughout rather than isolating them.
Rechecked every external final destination, removed the one unavailable assignment, and prohibited final-destination inference from a merely reachable URL.
Separated instructional Study resources from curriculum tasks and retained the single Study → Skill Check → Build → Proof → Reflect journey.
semanticValidation.adversarialResult: No unavailable active destination, curriculum-task Study card, unresolved Studio stage, or abstract Week 1 action remains.
